description: A practical overview of what to do in case of injury, lost child, fire, storm or conflict at the event. Printable version for the camp.
title: Safety and crisis situations
subtitle: What to do when something happens. A short practical card — print it out, take it with you.
location_value: Pulkovský mlýn, Rozkoš · Znojmo / Třebíč borderlands
medic_value: At registration / org tent (qualified medic for the whole event)
print_tip: Tip: print this card (Ctrl/Cmd+P) and take it with you. The signal in the area is not always reliable.
p1_s2: Secure the surroundings to prevent further injury.
p1_s4: Do not move the injured person unless necessary due to immediate danger.
p1_s5: In a serious case, call 155 or 112 and inform the organisers.
p2_title: When a child or participant is lost
p2_s1: Inform an organiser / registration / org tent immediately.
p2_s2: State the name, age, appearance, costume and where they were last seen.
p2_s3: Do not organise chaotic searching without arrangement with the organisers.
p2_s4: The organiser will determine the next steps.
p3_s2: Don’t fight the fire if it would endanger you.
p3_s4: Call 150 or 112 depending on the scale.
p3_s5: Clear access routes for the fire brigade.
p4_s4: When ordered to pause the game, end combat immediately and move to the designated place.
p5_s1: If it’s safe, clearly say that the behaviour bothers you.
p5_s2: If needed, contact an organiser, a confidant or a confidante.
p5_s3: Don’t resolve serious conflicts physically or with public lynching.
p5_s4: The organiser has the right to admonish, restrict or exclude a participant.
p6_s1: Going into battle under the influence of alcohol or intoxicants is forbidden.
p6_s2: Consumption is strictly forbidden during the battle.
p6_s3: An organiser may exclude a participant from the battle or the event.
